description: Update an existing form in the Form.io project mapped to the user's current working directory. IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, first use form_get to fetch the current form definition, then use the formio-schema skill to understand the schema so that you can apply the requested modifications (add, remove, or modify fields and settings), and finally call this tool with the complete updated form JSON. `draft`, `publish`, and `revert` are mutually exclusive — pass at most one. If `revisions` in the response differs from the stored value, the per-form revisions-mode gate prompted the USER and they chose.

cwd.description: User's current working directory as an absolute path. Selects the Form.io project that directory resolves to, by scope, narrowest first: a committed formio.json found by walking up from it, then the working-directory mapping project_set writes, then FORMIO_PROJECT_URL in the environment, which is the weakest of the three. Pass it on EVERY call whenever you know it: omitting it resolves against the MCP server's own working directory, which is fixed at spawn and may resolve to a different project. No environment variable removes the need for it — the environment is the source a file or a mapping overrides, not the one that overrides them.

draft.description: When true, create or update a draft (PUT /form/{formId}/draft) instead of publishing. Caller `form` fields merge on top of existing draft fields, preserving prior unpublished draft edits.

form.description: Complete updated Form.io form JSON definition

path.description: URL path segment for the form

revisions.description: Revision mode. Pass "" to disable; omit to leave the stored value unchanged.

formId.description: The _id of the form to update

note.description: Required note describing the diff (live form vs updated body) — no action preambles ("Published draft:", "Saved draft:", "Reverted:"). For `revert: true`, default to "Reverted to version {version}" unless the user explicitly provides a different note.

publish.description: When true, publish the current draft. Caller `form` body is ignored; only allowlisted revision fields flow from existing draft to live (PUT /form/{formId}).

revert.description: When true, revert the live form to a prior revision. Requires `version`. Caller `form` body is ignored; only allowlisted revision fields flow from the revision to live.

version.description: Revision identifier for `revert: true` — either the revision `_vid` (e.g. "3") or the revision document `_id` (24-char hex).

name: form_update

access.description: Role-based access to the form definition itself

components.description: Component tree defining the fields, layout, and logic of the form

machineName.description: Machine-readable unique name within the project

owner.description: ID of the submission owner, when set

path.description: URL path the form is served at, relative to the project

project.description: ID of the project owning the form

revisions.description: Revision mode: "original", "current", or false when disabled

submissionAccess.description: Role-based access to the submissions of this form

type.description: "form" for a form, "resource" for a data resource
